claims.claim_ar: الجذر: قَوْم — معنى الكلمة: جماعة من الناس/قوم
claims.claim_en: Root 'قوم' meaning: a group of people / a people (collective noun).

claims.claim_ar: الوزن الظاهري الاسمي: قَوْم على وزن فَعْل/فَعُول (اسم جماعة/جموعي)، تصنيفه في الأوزان الاسمية متباين في بعض المراجع.
claims.claim_en: Apparent nominal pattern: qawm corresponds roughly to the pattern fʿl / faʿūl (a collective noun formation). Classification among noun-patterns is somewhat variable in sources.
claims.needs_review_reason: classification of قَوْم among standard noun-pattern labels (فَعْل vs فَعُول) is not uniform across grammars; requires confirmation from a morphological dictionary.

claims.claim_ar: اللَّه: اسم الجلالة (اسم خاص) بمعنى الإله. لا يُستخلص وزناً ثلاثياً قياسياً بنفس طريقة أسماء الفعل الثلاثية الاعتيادية.
claims.claim_en: Allah: the divine proper name meaning 'God'. It is a proper noun and does not straightforwardly derive from a standard triliteral pattern like common nouns/verbs.
claims.needs_review_reason: assignment of a triliteral root to the divine name is traditional/analytical and debated; morphological derivation and root letters for الله are not agreed upon and need specialist review.

claims.claim_ar: اللَّه: اسم الجلالة (يتكرر في الآية) — معنى: الإله. كمصطلح صرفي، اشتقاق الجذر غير حاسم في المصادر التقليدية.
claims.claim_en: Allah (repeated in the verse): the proper name 'God'. From a morphological perspective, derivation/root assignment is not definitive in classical sources.
claims.needs_review_reason: see prior claim: root/derivation of the divine name is debated and requires specialist confirmation.

warnings: Provided source chunks do not contain exact substrings for many words in the ayah (e.g., أَفَأَمِنُوا, مَكْرَ, يَأْمَنُ, إِلَّا, الْخَاسِرُونَ). Claims are therefore limited to words for which matching substrings were found (الْقَوْمَ and الله تعالى).
Some morphological labels (especially pattern for قَوْم and root-assignment for اللَّه) are uncertain in the literature; those items have been marked with reduced confidence or needs_review.
